confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Taipei price levels; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and no web search was used for city-price anchors. Food and cafe anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel rates, which vary by district and season (July is peak summer demand). 2026 TWD/USD movement was not verified. Cocktail and wine_glass were positioned relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 to 3 times beer, wine_glass about 2 times beer) because direct knowledge of local bar and by-the-glass prices is weaker. The FX value came from search results summarizing RBA exchange-rate and homepage pages, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: large East Asian cities with dense street-food dining, cafes, and a mix of hostels and business hotels, loosely benchmarked against Seoul and Osaka. Taipei dining and cafe prices are judged at or somewhat below those cities; hostel and hotel rates are placed in a similar range. No single comparable city was used as a direct price source.
